mapper.select: SELECT pref_id AS "prefId", channel, enabled, consented, consented_at AS "consentedAt" FROM notification_preferences WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY CASE channel WHEN 'EMAIL' THEN 1 WHEN 'SMS' THEN 2 WHEN 'KAKAO' THEN 3 WHEN 'PUSH' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_preferences (tenant_id, user_id, channel, enabled, consented, consented_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{channel}, #{enabled}, #{consented}, CASE WHEN #{consented} = TRUE THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, user_id, channel) DO UPDATE SET enabled = #{enabled}, consented = #{consented}, consented_at = CASE WHEN #{consented} = TRUE AND notification_preferences.consented = FALSE THEN NOW() WHEN #{consented} = FALSE THEN NULL ELSE notification_preferences.consented_at END, updated_at = NOW()
